one_line.request: What is our on-time delivery rate?
one_line.text: Your on-time delivery rate is 85.3%. I joined deliveries to their delivery scans and averaged the on-time flag.
one_line.code:
result = con.sql("""
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS deliveries, AVG(d.on_time_flag) AS on_time_rate
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN scans s ON s.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    WHERE s.outcome = 'delivered'
""").df()
headline = {"on_time_rate": result.loc[0, "on_time_rate"]}
